description: This file defines the TextDumper class within Twig's Profiler Dumper package. The class extends BaseDumper and provides methods to format profiling data related to templates, non-template profiles, and timing information for display purposes.

classes.name: Twig\Profiler\Dumper\TextDumper
classes.description: A final class responsible for formatting profiler profile data for textual output, specifically for templates, non-templates, and time metrics.

methods.name: formatTemplate
methods.description: Formats the profile data related to a template, prefixing it with a specific symbol for visual hierarchy.

methods.name: formatNonTemplate
methods.description: Formats profile data representing non-template entities, including their type and name.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats the profiling duration and percentage into a human-readable string.
